$comment: Constellation requirements baseline (GAU-120). NASA SP-2016-6105 Rev 2 §6.2/§5.3. Methods: T test, A analysis, I inspection, D demonstration. T evidence = exact test names; A/I/D evidence = repo paths. Verified by `npm run verify`.

requirements.title: Freshness bound
requirements.statement: The system shall flag any served space-weather point whose measurement is older than 15 minutes as stale, and shall not carry a measurement forward beyond 15 minutes.
requirements.rationale: Operators must never act on expired data presented as current.
verifiedBy: latest feed: points older than 15 min are served flagged stale (GAU-15)
freshness tier follows measurement age, not fetch cadence (GAU-44)
data expires at 15 min without drifting values toward a baseline
ingest: an L1 data gap leaves the geomagnetic level known while NOAA Kp is current (GAU-138)

requirements.title: No synthetic variation
requirements.statement: The ingest pipeline shall not add variation to measured values between fetches.
requirements.rationale: Jitter makes stale data look live (GAU-44).
verifiedBy: ingest tick: no jitter between fetches, and an over-age readout is dropped (GAU-44)

requirements.title: Bounded ingest tick
requirements.statement: The ingest tick shall fetch sources in parallel within per-source time budgets and shall never start a tick while the previous one is running.
requirements.rationale: Sequential 8-9 s timeouts allowed ~40 s ticks and stacked ticks (GAU-110).
verifiedBy: tick reports per-stage latency, and sources are fetched in parallel
interval never stacks a tick on one still running
pipeline timer: a stage past its timeout is abandoned and counted

requirements.title: Pipeline health is observable
requirements.statement: The system shall report per-stage latency and an overall fresh/degraded/stale/stalled verdict derived from data age and loop liveness.
requirements.rationale: Technical performance measures need a live source (GAU-110).
verifiedBy: pipeline timer: rolling last/p50/p95/max per stage
pipeline timer: status follows data age and loop liveness

requirements.title: Aurora grid within budget
requirements.statement: The aurora grid shall be computed within its 1 s stage budget at nside 64 without changing the harmonic coefficients.
requirements.rationale: It was the dominant stage at 0.6-1.1 s (GAU-110).
verifiedBy: aurora grid at nside 64 builds within its 1 s pipeline budget
separable harmonics match the generic per-pixel sum

requirements.title: Historical replay through the live pipeline
requirements.statement: The system shall replay archived storm inputs through the same ingest, sense-check and nowcast code that runs live, on a fixed clock with no input served before it was published, without publishing to the live feed, and shall reproduce its golden output from the same inputs.
requirements.rationale: Radiation-study row 9 and M1 PR-03 groundwork (GAU-138, GAU-59): claims about past storms must come from the code that runs live, reproducibly.
verifiedBy: replay: the cached storms replay to their golden output, record for record (GAU-138)
replay: May 2024 reaches G5 and Oct 2024 G4 through the live pipeline (GAU-138)
replay: Jan 2026 reaches S4, with S2–S3 under G0 for hours before the geomagnetic storm (GAU-138)
replay: never publishes to the live feed (GAU-138)
archive: a row is served only once its interval has ended, so nothing leaks from the future (GAU-138)
archive: archived GSM is rotated to GSE with the live code; RTSW fills reach the parser as null (GAU-138)

requirements.title: Unknown is never nominal
requirements.statement: A missing, stale or failed input shall be reported as unknown and shall never be rendered as nominal, live, healthy or zero.
requirements.rationale: GAU-63 sales-gate invariant.
verifiedBy: measured drivers come only from current, complete measurements (GAU-114)
a feed response that omits its tier is not shown as live (GAU-114)
HUD never shows stale or missing data as fresh
unavailable placeholder is deterministic and never claims to be live
an unconfigured memory service is reported, not faked
JAXA: catalog reachability is not reported as a healthy data feed (GAU-55)
a missing, stale or wrong-channel proton reading is unknown, not S0
a missing, wrong-band or fill X-ray reading is unknown, not R0
NOAA: an HTTP failure is unknown, keeps the last real time, and names the product, not the URL (GAU-63)
NOAA: a newest L1 sample 30 min old is reported, but not as healthy (GAU-63)
NOAA: Kp fill values are skipped, never read as a quiet Kp 0 (GAU-63)
ESA: a Swarm sample 30 h old is returned but not healthy (GAU-63)
MMS: survey data older than 90 days is returned but not healthy (GAU-63)
NOAA alerts: a payload that isn't the alerts format is unknown (null), not 'no alerts' (GAU-63)
GAU-63: a point with no measurement time yields no observations, never ones stamped now

requirements.title: No fabricated model output
requirements.statement: The system shall not present random or heuristic values as trained-model output; with no model it shall answer 'unavailable' with a reason.
requirements.rationale: The '72h LSTM' forecast was Math.random() (GAU-111).
verifiedBy: no inference server: forecast is an explicit unavailable, never a number (GAU-111)
heuristic nowcast is deterministic, labelled, and claims no confidence (GAU-111)
inference server failures become unavailable with no URL in the reason (GAU-111)

requirements.title: Derived values carry provenance
requirements.statement: Every derived value shall carry the method and inputs it was derived from; measured values shall say they are measured.
requirements.rationale: GAU-63 provenance invariant; Dst was modelled but unlabelled (GAU-84).
verifiedBy: modelled Dst is labelled with its method and inputs; a measured Dst says so (GAU-84)
tick uses measured Kyoto Dst while fresh, and the model once it is stale (GAU-116)
ingest: a velocity assumed from the speed, or a locally rotated field, is labelled as derived (GAU-63)

requirements.title: Source freshness from data time
requirements.statement: Each source's lastSeen and latency shall be taken from the measurement time, never the request time, and a failed fetch shall keep the last real lastSeen.
requirements.rationale: Request-time freshness hides dead feeds (GAU-54).
verifiedBy: MMS: zero samples does not advance lastSeen to now (GAU-54)
LASP: valid file_info query, timetag parsed, freshness from the newest file (GAU-89)
GOES: status freshness comes from the older channel; failures keep the last real time (GAU-112)
Kyoto Dst: status from the data time; failures keep the last real time, no URL (GAU-116)

requirements.title: Fill values are missing, not zero
requirements.statement: Adapters shall treat fill, blank and non-numeric values as missing and shall never coerce them to zero.
requirements.rationale: Number('') is 0; GOES fill values are negative.
verifiedBy: MMS: fill-valued components are rejected rather than zeroed
GOES: newest valid sample of the S-scale channel; fill and null flux skipped (GAU-112)
Kyoto Dst: newest valid hour, read as UTC; blanks and bad times skipped (GAU-116)
Swarm rows: position plus B_NEC; any missing value rejects the row (GAU-85)

requirements.title: Times are UTC
requirements.statement: Zone-less upstream timestamps shall be interpreted as UTC and invalid ones rejected.
requirements.rationale: The host runs in UTC+8; local-time parsing shifts data by 8 h.
verifiedBy: NOAA: zone-less SWPC time_tags are read as UTC, invalid ones rejected
CSV rows with unparseable times are skipped, and compact times are UTC (GAU-114)

requirements.title: Inputs are sense-checked
requirements.statement: The system shall check each L1 magnetic-field sample, whether the L1 plasma speed follows large changes in the field, the GOES proton spectrum and channels, and the GOES X-ray channel for physical consistency, and shall cross-check its own R, S and G levels against NOAA's published scales; a failed check shall be reported with its reason without silently dropping the sample, and a check with no current input shall read unknown, not pass.
requirements.rationale: Radiation-study build order step 1 (GAU-134): sense-checks stop wrong conclusions before any analysis is built on them.
verifiedBy: field: Bt below the magnitude of its own components is flagged with a reason
field: GSE and GSM magnitudes that differ are flagged; a frame change can't alter |B|
plasma: a speed that holds while |B| triples to over 20 nT is flagged as not tracking (GAU-153)
plasma: a field that doubles at a steady speed, or a shock that moves the speed, is not flagged
plasma: too few samples in the window is unknown, not pass
replay: the stuck ACE speed in Jan 2026 is flagged and lowers confidence; May and Oct 2024 never flag it (GAU-153)
protons: a spectrum that rises with energy is flagged with both channels
channels: a fill as the newest sample is flagged; older fills are reported, not hidden
channels: a flat-lined channel is flagged as saturated or stuck
GOES X-rays: NOAA's electron-contamination mark on the newest sample is flagged (GAU-136)
NOAA scales: agreement passes; a disagreement is flagged with both values and Gauss's basis
NOAA scales: missing or over an hour old is unknown, never agreement
ingest: every point carries its sense-checks; an inconsistent newest field sample lowers confidence (GAU-136)
SWPC feeds: only HTTPS JSON on services.swpc.noaa.gov is fetched

requirements.title: Correct coordinate frames
requirements.statement: GSE/GSM transforms shall rotate about the shared X axis with the dipole tilt, and the IMF shall come from L1 monitors only.
requirements.rationale: GAU-51 frame mislabels; Swarm measures the main field (GAU-85).
verifiedBy: gseToGsm rotates about the shared X axis and puts the dipole on +Z
gsmToGse is the exact inverse of gseToGsm
dipole tilt follows season and UT (Hapgood 1992)
ingest: Swarm main-field values never leak into the IMF blend

requirements.title: Physically valid reconnection products
requirements.statement: Curlometer currents shall be in correct units, rejected for degenerate tetrahedra, and LMN frames shall be derived by MDD or reported unknown.
requirements.rationale: GAU-47/GAU-89 review findings.
verifiedBy: curlometer recovers a known current at real MMS separations (nA/m^2)
curlometer rejects a near-planar tetrahedron
MDD recovers the current-sheet normal and L along the reconnecting field (GAU-89)
MDD reports an unknown frame when no direction dominates (GAU-89)

requirements.title: Bounded Dst model
requirements.statement: The Dst model estimate shall track driving physically and shall not saturate at its clamp for ordinary IMF.
requirements.rationale: estimateDst saturated at -400 nT (GAU-62).
verifiedBy: Dst: quiet northward IMF stays near the pressure baseline, not a storm
Dst: weak southward IMF gives a modest equilibrium, never the -400 clamp
Dst: strong driving deepens over hours and relaxes back after
nowcast: constant input keeps Bz's sign and value across ticks (no component-mean shift)

requirements.title: Model promotion gate
requirements.statement: A forecasting model shall be served only after passing its held-out promotion gate, and promotion shall be an explicit step that refuses failed candidates.
requirements.rationale: GAU-38 guardrail: no automatic production model promotion (GAU-113).
verifiedBy: Kp model unit tests (python)
the real inference server serves the promoted Kp model, honestly (GAU-113)

requirements.title: Live forecast from measured history
requirements.statement: The live forecast shall be computed from the last 6 h of non-stale measured points and served from the ingest loop's cache.
verifiedBy: forecast window: last 6 h of measured points, one per minute (GAU-115)
the worker exposes its last forecast for the API to serve (GAU-115)

requirements.title: Model card
requirements.statement: Every promoted model shall have a model card stating data, splits, held-out metrics, gate result and known limitations.
requirements.rationale: Evaluation evidence (GAU-40).

requirements.title: Persistence robustness
requirements.statement: Local persistence shall read recent records in time bounded by the records requested, skip corrupt lines, and reload the last 24 h into memory after a restart.
requirements.rationale: 38 MB whole-file reads; one torn line hid all data (GAU-117).
verifiedBy: tail read returns the last lines in order without reading the whole file (GAU-117)
tail read keeps multi-byte UTF-8 intact across chunk boundaries (GAU-117)
bedrock skips corrupt and torn lines instead of returning nothing (GAU-117)
restart reload fills an empty buffer once, in order, and never duplicates (GAU-117)

requirements.title: Bounded memory
requirements.statement: In-memory feeds and windows shall be bounded.
requirements.rationale: Unbounded growth on an 8 GB host.
verifiedBy: caps coupling window length to prevent unbounded memory growth
canonical feed keeps a fixed-size ring buffer

requirements.title: Persistence failures are surfaced
requirements.statement: A failed telemetry write shall be counted and reported as a persist-stage error, shall not stop the point being served, and shall never crash the process.
requirements.rationale: Write failures were swallowed and the persist stage read ok (GAU-121, FMEA FM-10).
verifiedBy: FMEA: a failed telemetry write is counted and reported, and the tick still publishes (GAU-121)
FMEA: best-effort appends never reject (no unhandled rejection); strict appends do; both count (GAU-121)

requirements.title: Abuse protection
requirements.statement: The API shall block malicious signatures, rate-limit clients and auto-block repeated authentication failures.
requirements.rationale: CyberTiger baseline.
verifiedBy: blocks malicious signature and places IP on blocklist
rate limits after max requests within configured window
auth failure threshold auto-blocks IP

requirements.title: Upstream courtesy
requirements.statement: Adapters shall respect source cadences and not poll faster than the data updates.
requirements.rationale: Public APIs (NOAA, CDAWeb) rate-limit abusive clients.
verifiedBy: throttles NOAA fetches to once per 60s while worker ticks every 5s
allows MMS survey fetch on each 5s cadence boundary

requirements.title: Backend starts and reports health
requirements.statement: The backend shall start on an ephemeral port and answer /health.
requirements.rationale: Basic operational readiness.
verifiedBy: backend harness starts and responds to /health

requirements.title: IMF source decision recorded
requirements.statement: Architecture decisions affecting data provenance shall be recorded as ADRs.
requirements.rationale: GAU-85.

requirements.title: Technical performance measures
requirements.statement: The system shall report its technical performance measures with green/amber/red thresholds and margins, including live forecast skill against persistence and free disk, and shall expose only an overall status publicly.
requirements.rationale: NASA SE §6.7; closes FMEA FM-09 and FM-14 detection gaps (GAU-122).
verifiedBy: TPM: thresholds and margins for lower-is-better and higher-is-better measures (GAU-122)
TPM: overall status never lets 'insufficient' hide amber or red (GAU-122)
TPM: a cold first tick after restart is not a red p95 (GAU-122)
FMEA FM-09: live forecast skill is scored against observed Kp and compared with persistence (GAU-122)
FMEA FM-14: free disk is read from the data volume and graded (GAU-122)
backend harness starts and responds to /health

requirements.title: Controlled deployment
requirements.statement: Only verified release tags on main shall be deployed to the live checkout; every deploy shall be recorded, health-checked, and rolled back automatically when unhealthy.
requirements.rationale: NASA SE §6.5 configuration management and §5.5 transition (GAU-123).
verifiedBy: deploy: only verified tags on main to a clean checkout (GAU-123)
deploy: healthy release is activated and recorded; dry run changes nothing (GAU-123)
deploy: an unhealthy release rolls back automatically (GAU-123)
rollback: returns to the previous healthy release (GAU-123)

requirements.title: Deterministic, tamper-evident world records
requirements.statement: Every world-state record shall have a deterministic id and a SHA-256 checksum over its canonical content, and validation shall reject records whose content, id or schema do not match.
requirements.rationale: GAU-39 acceptance: deterministic IDs and checksums for every record; replays must be comparable.
verifiedBy: GAU-39: ids and checksums are deterministic, and tampering is detected
GAU-39: replay of a storm gives identical records, an onset event, an advisory and a transition

requirements.title: State reconstructable from bounded observations
requirements.statement: World state shall be reconstructable from a bounded, time-windowed observation sequence, independent of input order, using no stale or future observations, and without mutating operational data.
requirements.rationale: GAU-39 acceptance; exploratory coupling must not alter operational state.
verifiedBy: GAU-39: state is reconstructed from a bounded window; stale and future observations are not used
GAU-39: reconstruction is order-independent and does not mutate its inputs
GAU-39: live world state uses only the needed window of the feed, newest first

requirements.title: Provenance on every world value
requirements.statement: Every world-state value shall state whether it is measured, derived or unknown, with the observations or variables and method it rests on; missing inputs shall yield unknown, never a default.
requirements.rationale: GAU-39 acceptance: every derived value has provenance and truth state (GAU-63 invariant).
verifiedBy: GAU-39: observations carry only measured values, with unit, frame, platform and evidence
GAU-39: derived values carry method and inputs; unknown inputs give unknown, never a default
GAU-39: a lost source becomes a source-lost event, not silently carried
GAU-39: a forecast is a hypothesis resolved against observed state

requirements.title: Inference trust records
requirements.statement: For each inference the system shall return the space environment at the inference time, with each field's source, product URL, observed time, fetched time, age, confidence, method and limitations, and a verdict that is unknown whenever a required input is missing, stale or conflicting and is never consistent by default; a record shall carry no wording about harm to hardware or the odds of a wrong output.
requirements.rationale: PR-01 Inference Trust Record API, ICP-1 P0 (GAU-57): the buyer-facing product rests on provenance on every datum and fail-closed verdicts.
verifiedBy: trust record: a missing reading is unknown, never consistent (GAU-57)
trust record: a stale input is unknown, even when its level was quiet (GAU-57)
trust record: conflicting inputs are unknown: NOAA disagrees, or the proton spectrum is impossible (GAU-57)
trust record: every field carries source, product URL, observed and fetched times, age, confidence and limitations (GAU-57)
trust record: no wording about harm to hardware or odds of error, in any record (GAU-57)
trust record: p95 well under 500 ms over a full day of 5 s history (GAU-57)
trust record: through the replayed 19 Jan 2026 storm, S1 is consistent and S2 under G0 is degraded (GAU-57)
trust records API: an invalid inference is a 400 listing every error, nothing guessed (GAU-57)
trust records API: a batch returns records for valid items and the errors for the rest (GAU-57)
trust records API: a server without an environment history says so, never an empty record (GAU-57)
TLE: an epoch more than 7 days from the inference is not used (GAU-57)
trust record: an ephemeris and a TLE that disagree are conflicting inputs, so both read unknown (GAU-57)
TLE: format, catalogue number and the modulo-10 checksum are checked; satellite.js checks none of them (GAU-57)
